title: Hays summer 2026
author: Hays
desc: Get ready to transform your physique with the Hays Summer 2026 program! This intense 1-week plan packs 5 days of targeted workouts that focus on building strength and muscle across all major muscle groups. Each session includes a mix of machine and bodyweight exercises, such as weighted pull-ups and chest flies, designed to challenge you and push your limits. Perfect for those looking to maximize their gains in a short time, this program will leave you feeling stronger and more confident. Dive in and make this summer your best one yet!
